limits: Target is closest faithful2.5D adaptation; no pixel-perfect original footage or absolute1:1 certification.
Small front three-quarter KONAMI images do not attest hidden/rear microgeometry, concealed fingers, every engraving or original3D animations.

Opposing main cameras are separately authored, no software mirroring. Native PNG bytes remain intact; runtime vector component clipping excludes low-alpha generation fringe and neighboring atlas figures.

Twenty-one action groups per facing share14 mapped physical poses. Sixteen drawings exist per main atlas; high side kick and canister utility remain unused. Corrective low-left replaces one old high pose. Extra repair neutral/action figures are calibration-only or preserved, never represented as extra animation frames.

Only the visual deploy group expands from one canister pose to three HF frames at fps9 with explicit startup/active/recovery phase mapping. Original engine timings, HP, combat kit and actionMap remain unchanged.
Source MGR kit is authored CQC balancing, not timings/damage/motion capture from the original game. It has no projectile attacks; no firearm muzzle, grenade shot or bidon origin is invented.

SpecialDown now stages HF preparation, overhead HF action and guard recovery using existing visible blade poses; the unchanged CQC move label/timing does not certify a retail ascending-blade motion. Recover uses the neutral breathing stance, optic uses HF guard, charge uses HF preparation. No canister figure is selected by any action.
